aftercare.first48_1: Leave the initial wrap on for the time your artist tells you (usually 2–24 hours).
aftercare.first48_2: Wash gently with lukewarm water and fragrance-free soap. Pat dry — never rub.
aftercare.first48_3: Apply a thin layer of aftercare balm or ointment. Thin is key: too much suffocates the skin.
aftercare.first48_4: Keep it clean, keep it moisturized, and keep it out of the sun.
aftercare.p1_desc: Transparent adhesive wrap that protects your fresh tattoo for days — shower with it on, heal faster, less scabbing. The large pack covers bigger pieces.
aftercare.p2_desc: The industry-standard tattoo balm — vegan, petroleum-free, safe for fresh ink and great for keeping healed tattoos vibrant. A tub lasts a long time.
aftercare.p3_desc: The classic. Dermatologist-recommended, fragrance-free, and cheap — a thin layer keeps fresh tattoos protected and moisturized through the peel.
aftercare.p4_desc: Aftercare made for tattooed skin — built to soothe fresh ink and keep it healing clean. Our link applies the TAC20 discount automatically.
aftercare.recommend_sub: These are the products artists actually use. Buying through these links supports Tattoo Art Customs at no extra cost to you.
aftercare.sub: Heal it right and your ink stays bold for decades. Here's the routine real artists swear by.
aftercare.title: Tattoo Aftercare Guide
aftercare.weeks_1: Moisturize 2–3 times a day as the tattoo peels and flakes. Don't pick the flakes.
aftercare.weeks_2: No soaking — showers only, no baths, pools, or hot tubs for at least 2 weeks.
aftercare.weeks_3: No direct sun on the fresh tattoo. After it's healed, sunscreen keeps the colors from fading.
aftercare.p5_desc: Doctor-formulated staged aftercare — Ink Wash and Barrier Ointment for fresh ink, Recovery Milk and Itch Calm Gel for the peel, Daily Lotion and SPF 50 for healed tattoos. Fragrance-free, barrier-first.
aftercare.p6_desc: Professional aftercare made for fresh ink — pain relief and healing support to keep your new tattoo healing clean.
aftercare.p7_desc: Studio-grade supplies and aftercare from the UK — the machines, inks and healing essentials artists stock their stations with. Please note: Monsters Ink does not currently ship to the USA — US shipping returns shortly. Orders from other countries ship as normal.

story.title: A working studio, not a clip-art mill
story.p1: Tattoo Art Customs is the storefront of Useful Appz Development Studios, an independent studio in Abbeville, Louisiana. Every design in the gallery — {count} and growing — is original work by independent tattoo designers, never stock art: a finished full-color piece plus the clean linework your artist stencils from, delivered together when you buy.
story.p2: Why build a catalog this deep? Because a tattoo is a one-time decision you wear for life, and nobody should have to settle for the least-bad option on a shop wall. A deep catalog means the design fits the person — their story, their body, their artist's hand — instead of the other way around. And when nothing on the shelves is quite it, the custom desk draws it: describe what you want, approve the direction, and the finished design is yours within 48 hours.
story.p3: The studio is bigger than the gallery. The same team builds the apps on this site, produces two shows — Color With Us, where featured designs are colored on screen, and Poppy & Ziggy, our educational series for kids — and runs Little Inkers, the free coloring app for children. One small studio in Louisiana, doing all of it in-house.

tappay.intro: Your customers tap their card or phone on yours. No card reader, no extra hardware — just your phone.
tappay.card1_text: Turn on PayPal Tap to Pay on your phone — free, about five minutes. PayPal takes 2.29% + 9¢ per tap; the rest is yours.
tappay.card2_text: Solo $9.99/mo for one chair, Studio $19.99/mo for 2–4 chairs, Shop $29.99/mo for 5+ chairs. A standalone service, billed separately from your shop subscription — keep the bill current to keep the service. Optional: add half a percent to the customer's bill at the register — 50¢ on a $100 tattoo — to cover some or all of the fee.

dguide.title: Designer Guide
dguide.sub: Everything you need to submit great by-request designs and earn.
dguide.intro_h: Your work here is the product
dguide.intro_text: There is no stock library behind this marketplace — clients come because independent designers draw things nobody else has. By-request work is a conversation: a client describes the piece they are dreaming about, you confirm it is in your hand, and the studio handles payment, file delivery and the client relationship so your hours go to drawing. The specs below are what make a design sell and print cleanly — read them before your first submission, and your work will go live faster.
dguide.spec1: Linework: clean black lines, JPG/PNG/WebP, max 15 MB per image.
dguide.spec2: Color version optional but recommended — full-color designs sell better.
dguide.spec3: Minimum 2000px on the longest side for crisp prints.
dguide.spec4: No watermarks of your own on the art — the site applies its own.
dguide.spec5: Original interpretations only — draw the character in YOUR style, never trace or copy existing art.
dguide.style1: Tattoo-ready: bold readable shapes that work at tattoo size.
dguide.style2: Clean linework that a tattoo artist can stencil from.
dguide.style3: Your own artistic voice — clients pick designers for their style.
dguide.style4: No AI-generated submissions — hand-drawn or digitally painted by you.
dguide.request_p1: The 300-character list is request-only. Designs you submit never appear in the public gallery — they become available when a customer requests that character.
dguide.request_p2: Claim characters before someone else does:
dguide.claim1: First come, first served — once claimed, no one else can do that character.
dguide.claim2: Release a claim anytime if you change your mind.
dguide.claim3: Submitting a design for a character auto-completes your claim.
dguide.pay_p1: By-request designs earn a boosted rate: 80% of the sale goes to you (vs the standard 70%), funded from the site's share.
dguide.pay_p2: Payouts go to your PayPal once you're registered, subscribed, and your payout email is set.
dguide.submit_p: Submit up to 10 designs at once, each tagged to its character.

testers.title: Become a Tester — Help Launch Our Apps
testers.intro: Every app here needs 12 testers opted in before Google Play lets it launch. Tap an app, hit Become a tester, and stay opted in for about two weeks. The whole list takes about two minutes.
testers.done: Tattoo Art Customs (free) — DONE! 12+ testers reached ✅ — thank you!
testers.share: Know someone with an Android phone? Share this page — every tester gets an app closer to launch.
testers.note: Free forever, Android only. Use the Google account that's on your phone. Already a tester on an app? No need to tap it again — just grab any you're missing.
testers.apps_link: 🧪 Become a tester — help launch our apps
testers.pool_pitch: Useful Appz is a tiny studio, and this is our standing tester pool. Join once, and you're first in line for every app we ever test — you get new apps before anyone else, and your testing is what gets them launched.
testers.pool_how: Here's how it works: join the pool below, and when a new test opens we tap you with that app's link. Prefer tapping in right now? The apps that are open today are listed below — the button takes you to Google Play, where your tap is the one that counts.
testers.pool_count: {count} people are already in the tester pool.
testers.form_note: Joining the pool doesn't sign you up for an app by itself — Google only counts your tap on the app's own Google Play page. The pool just makes sure you hear about every new test first. We only email you about app testing, and you can ask to be removed any time.
